ai_summary: Alphageo (India) Limited has announced its 39th Annual General Meeting (AGM) will be held virtually on September 18, 2026. The company has fixed September 11, 2026, as the Record Date for determining shareholder eligibility for the financial year 2025-26 dividend and for voting on resolutions at the AGM. This is a routine corporate governance filing with no apparent red flags, primarily impacting shareholders who need to hold shares by the record date to exercise their rights.
